test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 9 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. No Boy is a Singer.

2. All Singers are Musicians. 

3. All Musicians are Actors.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Musicians cannot be Boys.

II. All Boys are Actors.

III. No Actor is a Boy.
solution:
The least possible Venn Diagram of the above statement is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a36bedf19229c014f8f8d33eb3ed082de37c4d91fbec993170e133bf36c3f104.png] 

I. All Musicians cannot be Boys → **Follows **(Since all singers are musicians and no boy is a singer, then it is definite that all musicians can not be Boys)

II. All Boys are Actors → Does not follows (As per the above Venn diagram, it is possible but not definite. So All boys are actors is false)

III. No Actor is a Boy → Does not follows (As per the above Venn diagram, some actors are not boys is definite but no actor is a boy is a possibility. Hence, No actor is a boy is false)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follow".**
